title: Chat line editor state diagram
description: The chat client's Editor (chat_client.rs) while Raw::next feeds it bytes from a raw-mode terminal: Editor::feed tracks an escape sequence being skipped and a UTF-8 character split across bytes, and says what each byte means. Raw::next redraws the line on Redraw and returns on the other keys.
machine: Editor (chat_client.rs), driven by Raw::next through Editor::feed

states.description: No escape sequence or partial character pending: bytes edit the line or end it.
Some bytes of a UTF-8 character have arrived; it is added to the line when complete, dropped after four bytes or by a backspace.
ESC arrived; the next byte decides whether a sequence follows.
Inside an escape sequence such as an arrow key, which is skipped up to its final byte.
The line was sent (Enter) or input ended: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+K, or Ctrl+D on an empty line. Raw::next returns the key; the editor starts typing again on the next call.

transitions.trigger: a printable byte, backspace or Ctrl+U
transitions.guard: It completes a character or edits the line

transitions.trigger: a byte that starts a multi-byte character
the byte that completes the character, a backspace, or a fourth invalid byte

transitions.guard: Ctrl+D only on an empty line
